name: hunt_fv_oside5_a1m3_vwap

source.title: Claude hunt 2026-10-20 (lens: fair value gaps at higher frequency): the owner's open-side FVG moved to 5-minute bars, with the session VWAP as a second side that must agree with the 09:30 open, a 3 x 1-minute-ATR stop and 1:1.5, up to 3 a day. Why it should pay: above both the 09:30 open and the VWAP the day's buyers are in control by price and by volume, and the newest 5-minute up gap is their buying that was left unfilled; the first return to it meets that resting interest and the move resumes (the mirror below both). Who loses: the traders who fade the day's side into the gap -- shorts sold above the open and the VWAP, dip-buyers below both -- whose stops beyond the gap pay for the continuation.

entry.words: On 5-minute candles from 09:30: above the 09:30 open AND above the session VWAP, rest a buy limit at the near edge of the newest up fair value gap (at least 0.1 x ATR(14) tall); below the open AND below the VWAP, a sell limit at the newest down gap. A newer gap or a flip of the side moves the order; no new order from 15:00. Stop 3 x the average true range of the last 14 one-minute bars from the entry, target 1.5 x the stop. Up to 3 trades a day, one at a time; after a trade only a gap formed after it counts. Flat 15:58.

[Claude hunt 2026-10-20, prior knowledge read before this sheet: result.json of owner_fvg_oside_5_r1 and owner_fvg_oside_5_atr1] the 5-minute open-side FVG with no second side and a narrow stop was near break-even at 1R on build days (about 1 a day); this sheet changes the stop to the wide 3 x 1m-ATR and adds the VWAP side for reasons of the rule, and no number was tuned to those results
not_run: PARTLY SEEN: the fvg_oside family's unseen months (2025-07 on) were read three times on 15-minute bars (the 1-a-day sibling's walk-forward, the lane's no-cap walk-forward, the Desk walk-forward) and again in cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1's walk-forward. This 5-minute sheet with a VWAP side makes different trades on the same months: its walk-forward is not fully blind.

THE VWAP: the engine's session VWAP, which restarts at each session pass start (09:30, 11:00 and 13:30 ET), not one VWAP from 09:30; the gate reads (close - VWAP) / sigma at the gap's 5-minute close (closed bars only): above 0 for a long, below 0 for a short. The gate is checked when the order is placed or moved.
THE SIDE vs the 09:30 open is read on each 5-minute close, not tick by tick.
THE STOP: 3 x the mean true range of the 14 newest completed 1-minute bars at the gap's close, measured from the near edge, without the engine's 0.25 x tf-ATR floor (two ticks only).
ONE INSTANCE 09:30-15:58: the cap of 3 is a DAY cap and one position at a time holds all day; an unfilled order is cancelled at 15:00.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay, strict limit fills).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
